description: This file defines the MatcherValidationEvent class within the Goteo application, responsible for evaluating various scoring and validation logic related to matchers, including profile completeness, overview details, questionnaire responses, and configuration data.

classes.name: MatcherValidationEvent
classes.description: A class that validates and scores a Matcher object based on various criteria such as profile completeness, overview information, questionnaire responses, and configuration details.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates the overall score based on individual category scores.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal score, error, and field containers to initial state.

methods.name: setKeys
methods.description: Sets the keys used for different scoring categories.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves the current set of scoring category keys.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Retrieves form fields associated with errors.

methods.name: getScores
methods.description: Returns the accumulated scores for each category.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns the errors identified during validation.

methods.name: getProfileScore
methods.description: Calculates score based on profile completeness and social links.

methods.name: getOverviewScore
methods.description: Calculates score based on the overview information provided.

methods.name: getCriteriaScore
methods.description: Calculates score based on presence of questionnaire data.

methods.name: getConfigurationScore
methods.description: Calculates score based on configuration variables.
